title: Drive and Dropbox token refresh has no single flight: a save, the watch loop and a document read can each refresh at once; the watch loops never tell the page a grant is dead
evidence: Was: step 1 done (PR 1487); step 2 decided, waits on PR 1458. Step 1, PR 1487 (merge 3fcac0d23): one refresh per (provider, refresh token) per page (widget-src/src/storage/token-flight.ts); Drive forgets a sign-in only on invalid_grant; api.google-token answers 502 for invalid_client at any 4xx. US-09 AC47. Step 2 (after PR 1458): the watch loops raise a page-level sign-in-ended signal, stop polling, and the storage bar shows Reconnect without a reload (lead A26). Brad decided 2026-11-13: B-1, the existing reconnect panel at once, no reload, no new notice; B-2, Dropbox forgets only on invalid_grant, as Drive; Q1, Dropbox uses Drive's words with the name swapped (US-09 AC48). Owner rulings 2026-11-13: one sign-in state with a pure transition; raise on any 400/401, forget only on invalid_grant, which also closes N1 (no re-post per save once raised); an API 401 zeroes the cached expiry so the refresh decides; another tab's clear raises only while BACKEND_KEY and the log-off id are unchanged; the load-time reconnect prop is deleted in the same PR; Dropbox gets an empty config key like Drive's, kept by an erase; data pins (edits after the raise survive Use this browser only, the picker copy-down and a reconnect) gate the build. N3 (Drive answers none for a kept, refused grant) is handled by the raise. Design: side-session notes a3-step2-design.md. Order: 1458, a byte-pure drive.ts split, the pins, the build.
